fields.why: Table 1 sets prevalences and average APCs across 3+ age, education and race groups side by side, and the text ranks the APCs across groups ('ranged from 0.3 ... to 0.7'), which looks groupwise under F.
Age (5 levels), education (4) and race/ethnicity (4 shown, 3 interpreted) each have 3+ groups with values shown; urban/rural and sex have 2, and Census region is not an SPD.

No test across SPD levels is reported: the adjusted Wald tests compare 2016-2017 with 2008-2009 within each SPD level (a non-SPD contrast, rule 6), so the mechanical flag is a false hit. APCs by group are only ranged, not compared by a test.

brief_issues: Rule 4 says joinpoint APCs 'compared by group' make a groupwise entry but does not say whether APCs merely ranged across groups with no test count; side by side is the natural reading.
